files.README.md:
# Westgate Campus portal

The portal serves student records, timetabling and facilities for the Westgate
campuses.

The documentation portal resolves each link on a page by matching its file
name against every file in the repository; an entry whose name matches no file
is reported as unresolved. INDEX.md lists the standing operations references.
files.docs/facilities-plan.md:
# Facilities plan

Teaching rooms are reassigned each term by the timetabling office. Maintenance
requests are raised against a room code and routed to the campus estates team.
files.docs/ops/deploy-guide.md:
# Deploy guide

Deployments run from the release branch. The portal team promotes a build to
the staging campus, checks the sign-in path, then promotes to the production
campuses.

Out-of-hours deploys are announced in the operations channel.
files.docs/ops/runbook.md:
# Operations runbook

1. Confirm the nightly student record import has finished.
2. Check the timetabling queue depth on the portal dashboard.
3. Escalate to the on-call engineer when the queue stops draining.

Backups are verified every Monday by the platform team.
